test_cases.name: offers_workflow_then_stops_at_stage1
test_cases.input: Viết giúp tôi một PRD cho tính năng đăng nhập bằng OTP
assertions: Offers the three-stage workflow (Context Gathering, Refinement & Structure, Reader Testing) and lets the user accept or decline
After the user accepts, starts at Stage 1 Context Gathering
Does NOT draft the whole document in the same turn

test_cases.name: user_declines_workflow_goes_freeform
test_cases.input: Không cần quy trình gì hết, viết luôn RFC này theo kiểu tự do
assertions: Accepts the refusal and writes freeform
Does NOT push the three-stage workflow again

test_cases.name: asks_5_to_10_numbered_questions
test_cases.input: Đây là toàn bộ context của tôi về dự án thanh toán: [dump dài]. Hết rồi.
assertions: Asks 5-10 numbered clarifying questions based on gaps in the dump
Tells the user they can answer in shorthand such as '1: yes, 2: see #channel'
Asks whether there is more context before moving to drafting

test_cases.name: confirms_before_searching_unknown_entities
test_cases.input: Doc này liên quan project Atlas, bạn tìm hiểu giúp
assertions: Asks whether connected tools should be searched
Waits for the user's confirmation before searching
When no integration is available, explains the lack of access and asks the user to paste the content

test_cases.name: section_by_section_refinement
test_cases.input: Cấu trúc ok rồi, bắt đầu viết các section
assertions: For each section: asks clarifying questions, brainstorms options, asks the user to curate by number, then drafts
Treats freeform feedback like 'I like most of it but...' as curation and applies it
Does NOT draft all sections at once

test_cases.name: edits_only_requested_section
test_cases.input: Sửa lại section Goals thôi, các section khác giữ nguyên
assertions: Edits only the Goals section
Does NOT rewrite the rest of the document

test_cases.name: reader_testing_with_fresh_subagent
test_cases.input: Tất cả section xong rồi, chuyển sang Reader Testing
assertions: Generates realistic questions a reader would ask
Invokes a sub-agent given only the document content and one question each, with no conversation context
Summarizes what Reader Claude got right and wrong for each question
Fixes the ambiguity, false assumption, or contradiction found

test_cases.name: not_for_code_edits
assertions: Does NOT start the co-authoring workflow
Treats the request as a code task
